answer: In a logistic regression model predicting BA degree completion with an interaction between race and socioeconomic status (SES), the factor (log-odds regression coefficient) of BA degree completion is -0.9568 between Black and White individuals when Black respondents are compared to White respondents as the reference group (evaluated at SES = 0).
